observations.result: Framework detected one source, __NUXT_DATA__ (1.2 KB), and used it for the query. Only one source existed on this page, so there was no alternate source button to select and no multi-source highlight behavior to exercise.
After refreshing the Nuxt page, Reload tree completed and retained the same real __NUXT_DATA__ tree (108 payload items; 100 visible at a time). No loading or error state remained.

Selecting nested path 7.repo and running Extract produced one row with value 10. The live serialized source tree itself shows 7.repo -> 10 and payload slot 10 -> "nuxt/nuxt". The preview returned the raw devalue reference index, not the referenced string, while the card reported OK. This report records 10 as the observed result and does not claim that the preview returned "nuxt/nuxt".

The preview for source __NUXT_DATA__ and key_path ["7","repo"] showed one row, value 10. Changing the draft tree selection to 7.name left the executed preview unchanged; the Save form default remained Framework: 7.repo. The uniquely named pattern saved with the executed config, was reopened in Patterns, and replayed to one row with value 10. The config round trip is bounded-pass; the raw-reference result means data-value acceptance fails.

After navigation to https://example.com/, Framework displayed No embedded framework data and disabled Extract from key path. No stale Framework preview appeared on that tab. The Patterns list still showed the saved nuxt.com pattern labeled with its source domain and prior row count.
